# Bibliographic lookup — 19 November 2026

Generated 2026-11-19T12:36:04.345Z. Source records: `src/data/references.ts`.

## Method and limits

Batched Crossref (filter=doi:…) lookups for DOIs and NCBI E-utilities esummary for PMIDs, with a best-effort Europe PMC DOI fallback. Title coverage is the fraction of resolved-title words present in the supplied citation; a three-word prefix match also counts. A match verifies bibliographic identity only, never that the source supports the claim.

A `match` is bibliographic identity only. It does **not** prove that the source supports the sentence it is attached to, and it is not clinical validation. Records with no DOI/PMID, failed lookups, unresolved identifiers and citations too short to compare are listed as incomplete checks.
